lesson.introText:
Hey guys! I’m BUDDY! Today, we’ll learn a little melody that changes the meaning of a question in English. It’s... …TAG QUESTIONS! Listen to the music at the end of these: isn’t it?

When our voice goes DOWN, we already know it and we just confirm. When our voice goes UP, we really don’t know, and we want an answer.
